description: Charming townhouse, next to Paris, in a pedestrian alley, absolutely quiet, 500 meters from the metro and close to all shops. Very bright, and with a beautiful terrace to enjoy the sun ☀️ Covered parking available 🚘 The house consists of a living room and kitchen opening to the outside, a double bedroom on the 1st floor, with shower room – toilet, a double bedroom on the ground floor, with shower room – toilet, and its dressing room with a single bed. The sofa is convertible.The spaceRefurbished house.High speed internet - fiber. Living room with sofa bed and TV facing it.Fully equipped kitchen, with oven, dishwasher, microwave, Nespresso machine, toaster etc.2 bathrooms, each with shower and toilet.Large dressing room with single bed Washing machine.Everything is new and the house has a small air conditioning system that is more than enough to have a pleasant temperature in hot weather.Guest accessThe entire house
